import bpy
import math
import random
from mathutils import Vector

# Clean scene
bpy.ops.object.select_all(action='SELECT')
bpy.ops.object.delete()

# Set up basic scene
scene = bpy.context.scene
scene.render.resolution_x = 1920
scene.render.resolution_y = 1080
scene.render.film_transparent = False

# Night sky color
world = bpy.data.worlds.get("World") or bpy.data.worlds.new("World")
scene.world = world
world.use_nodes = True
bg_node = world.node_tree.nodes.get("Background")
if bg_node:
    bg_node.inputs[0].default_value = (0.02, 0.03, 0.08, 1.0)
    bg_node.inputs[1].default_value = 1.0

# Add a subtle moon
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=15, location=(200, -500, 150))
moon = bpy.context.active_object
moon.name = "Moon"
mat = bpy.data.materials.new("MoonMat")
mat.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.95, 0.8, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = 5.0
bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.8, 0.8, 0.7, 1.0)
moon.data.materials.append(mat)

# Ground / water surface
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=600, location=(0, 0, -2))
ground = bpy.context.active_object
ground.name = "WaterSurface"
mat = bpy.data.materials.new("WaterMat")
mat.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.02, 0.05, 0.12, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.1
bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = 0.3
ground.data.materials.append(mat)

# Bathhouse base - large platform
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, 0, 0))
platform = bpy.context.active_object
platform.name = "BathhousePlatform"
platform.scale = (60, 40, 2)
mat = bpy.data.materials.new("WoodDarkMat")
mat.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.15, 0.08, 0.04, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.8
platform.data.materials.append(mat)

# Main bathhouse body
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, 5, 5))
main_body = bpy.context.active_object
main_body.name = "BathhouseMain"
main_body.scale = (50, 30, 8)
mat = bpy.data.materials.new("WoodBathMat")
mat.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.35, 0.18, 0.08, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.7
main_body.data.materials.append(mat)

# Upper floor
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, 5, 12))
upper = bpy.context.active_object
upper.name = "BathhouseUpper"
upper.scale = (45, 25, 5)
upper.data.materials.append(mat)

# Roof - traditional Japanese curved roof
# Main roof
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=4, radius1=55, radius2=20, depth=12, location=(0, 5, 20))
roof = bpy.context.active_object
roof.name = "MainRoof"
roof.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.radians(45))
roof.scale = (1.2, 0.9, 1)
mat_roof = bpy.data.materials.new("RoofTileMat")
mat_roof.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat_roof.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.1, 0.1, 0.12, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.5
roof.data.materials.append(mat_roof)

# Upper roof
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=4, radius1=45, radius2=15, depth=10, location=(0, 5, 27))
roof2 = bpy.context.active_object
roof2.name = "UpperRoof"
roof2.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.radians(45))
roof2.scale = (1.1, 0.85, 1)
roof2.data.materials.append(mat_roof)

# Top spire/ornament
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=8, radius1=3, radius2=0.5, depth=8, location=(0, 5, 35))
spire = bpy.context.active_object
spire.name = "RoofSpire"
mat_spire = bpy.data.materials.new("GoldMat")
mat_spire.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat_spire.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.8, 0.6, 0.2, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs["Metallic"].default_value = 1.0
bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.3
spire.data.materials.append(mat_spire)

# Windows - glowing warm light
for i in range(8):
    x = -25 + i * 7
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(x, 20.5, 5))
    win = bpy.context.active_object
    win.name = f"Window_{i}"
    win.scale = (2.5, 0.5, 3)
    mat_win = bpy.data.materials.new(f"WindowGlow_{i}")
    mat_win.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat_win.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.7, 0.3, 1.0)

    bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = 3.0
    win.data.materials.append(mat_win)

# Upper floor windows
for i in range(6):
    x = -20 + i * 8
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(x, 27.5, 12))
    win2 = bpy.context.active_object
    win2.name = f"UpperWindow_{i}"
    win2.scale = (2, 0.5, 2.5)
    mat_win2 = bpy.data.materials.new(f"UpperWindowGlow_{i}")
    mat_win2.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat_win2.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.65, 0.25, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.55, 0.15, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = 2.5
    win2.data.materials.append(mat_win2)

# Red bridge
bridge_length = 80
bridge_y_start = 40
# Bridge deck
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, bridge_y_start + bridge_length/2, 1))
bridge_deck = bpy.context.active_object
bridge_deck.name = "BridgeDeck"
bridge_deck.scale = (8, bridge_length/2, 0.5)
mat_bridge = bpy.data.materials.new("RedBridgeMat")
mat_bridge.use_nodes = True
bsdf = mat_bridge.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.6, 0.05, 0.05, 1.0)
bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.6
bridge_deck.data.materials.append(mat_bridge)

# Bridge railings
for side in [-1, 1]:
    for i in range(15):
        y = bridge_y_start + i * 5
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(side * 4, y, 1.5))
        post = bpy.context.active_object
        post.name = f"BridgePost_{side}_{i}"
        post.scale = (0.3, 0.3, 1.5)
        post.data.materials.append(mat_bridge)

# Railing bars
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(side * 4, bridge_y_start + bridge_length/2, 2.5))
    rail = bpy.context.active_object
    rail.name = f"BridgeRail_{side}"
    rail.scale = (0.3, bridge_length/2, 0.2)
    rail.data.materials.append(mat_bridge)

# Bridge support pillars
for i in range(4):
    y = bridge_y_start + 10 + i * 20
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=1, depth=3, location=(0, y, -0.5))
    pillar = bpy.context.active_object
    pillar.name = f"BridgePillar_{i}"
    mat_pillar = bpy.data.materials.new("StonePillarMat")
    mat_pillar.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat_pillar.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.4, 0.35, 0.3, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 0.9
    pillar.data.materials.append(mat_pillar)

# Lanterns along the bridge
for i in range(6):
    y = bridge_y_start + 5 + i * 12
    for side in [-1, 1]:
        # Lantern post
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.2, depth=3, location=(side * 3, y, 2))
        lpost = bpy.context.active_object
        lpost.name = f"LanternPost_{side}_{i}"
        lpost.data.materials.append(mat_bridge)
        
        # Lantern body
        bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=0.8, location=(side * 3, y, 3.5))
        lantern = bpy.context.active_object
        lantern.name = f"Lantern_{side}_{i}"
        lantern.scale = (1, 1, 1.3)
        mat_lantern = bpy.data.materials.new(f"LanternGlow_{side}_{i}")
        mat_lantern.use_nodes = True
        bsdf = mat_lantern.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
        bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.3, 0.1, 1.0)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.4, 0.1, 1.0)
        bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = 8.0
        lantern.data.materials.append(mat_lantern)

# Bathhouse entrance lanterns
for x in [-15, 15]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=0.3, depth=4, location=(x, 25, 3))
    elpost = bpy.context.active_object
    elpost.name = f"EntranceLanternPost_{x}"
    elpost.data.materials.append(mat_bridge)
    
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=1, location=(x, 25, 5))
    elantern = bpy.context.active_object
    elantern.name = f"EntranceLantern_{x}"
    elantern.scale = (1, 1, 1.4)
    mat_elantern = bpy.data.materials.new(f"EntranceLanternGlow_{x}")
    mat_elantern.use_nodes = True
    bsdf = mat_elantern.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.35, 0.1, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Emission Color"].default_value = (1.0, 0.45, 0.15, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Emission Strength"].default_value = 10.0
    elantern.data.materials.append(mat_elantern)

# Steam particles - use simple spheres with low opacity
for i in range(20):
    x = random.uniform(-20, 20)
    y = random.uniform(15, 35)
    z = random.uniform(10, 30)
    size = random.uniform(1, 3)
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_uv_sphere_add(radius=size, location=(x, y, z))
    steam = bpy.context.active_object
    steam.name = f"Steam_{i}"
    mat_steam = bpy.data.materials.new(f"SteamMat_{i}")
    mat_steam.use_nodes = True
    mat_steam.blend_method = 'BLEND'
    bsdf = mat_steam.node_tree.nodes.get("Principled BSDF")
    bsdf.inputs["Base Color"].default_value = (0.9, 0.9, 0.95, 1.0)
    bsdf.inputs["Alpha"].default_value = 0.15
    bsdf.inputs["Roughness"].default_value = 1.0
    steam.data.materials.append(mat_steam)

# Side wings of bathhouse
for side in [-1, 1]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(side * 35, 10, 4))
    wing = bpy.context.active_object
    wing.name = f"BathhouseWing_{side}"
    wing.scale = (15, 20, 5)
    wing.data.materials.append(mat)
    
    # Wing roof
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cone_add(vertices=4, radius1=18, radius2=8, depth=8, location=(side * 35, 10, 10))
    wroof = bpy.context.active_object
    wroof.name = f"WingRoof_{side}"
    wroof.rotation_euler = (0, 0, math.radians(45))
    wroof.scale = (1, 0.8, 1)
    wroof.data.materials.append(mat_roof)

# Additional structural columns
for x in [-45, -30, 30, 45]:
    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cylinder_add(radius=1.5, depth=16, location=(x, 20, 8))
    col = bpy.context.active_object
    col.name = f"Column_{x}"
    col.data.materials.append(mat)

# Decorative beams
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_cube_add(size=1, location=(0, 20, 16))
beam = bpy.context.active_object
beam.name = "MainBeam"
beam.scale = (50, 1, 1)
beam.data.materials.append(mat)

# Set up camera
bpy.ops.object.camera_add(location=(0, 120, 20))
camera = bpy.context.active_object
camera.name = "MainCamera"
scene.camera = camera
camera.rotation_euler = (math.radians(80), 0, 0)

# Add a light to simulate moonlight
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='SUN', location=(50, -100, 100))
sun = bpy.context.active_object
sun.name = "Moonlight"
sun.data.energy = 0.5
sun.data.color = (0.7, 0.8, 1.0)
sun.rotation_euler = (math.radians(45), math.radians(20), 0)

# Warm fill light from the bathhouse
bpy.ops.object.light_add(type='POINT', location=(0, 20, 10))
warm_light = bpy.context.active_object
warm_light.name = "BathhouseWarmLight"
warm_light.data.energy = 500
warm_light.data.color = (1.0, 0.6, 0.3)
warm_light.data.shadow_soft_size = 5
